A '''snap baton''' was a collapsible [[Baton/Legends|baton]] that expanded from 12 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] to one [[Meter/Legends|meter]]. They were easily concealable or carried in a pocket or [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]]. Some custom upgrades (which doubled the price) that were sometimes incorporated included a panic button or a built-in [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]]. Many models existed, but the Merr-Sonn model was covered in a thin layer of dark sound absorbing material to help reduce the noise when the baton was deployed or used.<ref name="AEG" />

Popular in urban areas, snap batons were used as weapons by thugs and as items for personal protection.
